name: 갈대개구리
appearance: Long-legged bronze-green marsh frog, reed blade crest, broad flattened mouth and visible webbed toes.

motions.stand: Facing left, throat inflates and deflates once, eyes blink, webbed front toes flex and reed crest nods slightly, loop back to the crouched alert pose.
motions.move: Facing left, crouch the long hind legs, push into a small forward-oriented hop in place, extend both hind legs fully during airborne phase, land on front webbed toes and fold the legs back for a seamless hopping cycle.
motions.attack1: Facing left, compress the long hind legs deeply, then spring the head and shoulders forward left in a short forceful body lunge with open broad mouth, land and pull hind legs back under the body, return to guard. No tongue projectile.
motions.hit1: Facing left, eyes squeeze shut and head recoils right, front webbed feet spread to brace while hind legs compress, recover original crouch.
motions.die1: Facing left, throat stops inflating, front legs buckle and broad head drops, long hind legs relax to the side, eyes close and finish slumped motionless on the ground.
